question: Can the already validated exact local OmniLidar USDA produce one legal complete GMO scan through the Isaac Sim 6.0.1 renderProduct Writer callback before any Cano raycasting is retried?
method: Keep the v1 deterministic six-wall analytic box, exact local OmniLidar USDA, RTX Lidar Core backend, one sensor, one fixed pose, 16x720/10 Hz/0.3-50 m profile and 300-frame limit unchanged. Replace only direct LidarSensor.get_data polling with the Writer renderProduct callback pattern used by the bundled Isaac Sim 6.0.1 lidar runtime test. Require the already passed SensorChecker and exact attribute read-back gates plus a legal GMO header, numElements greater than zero, scanComplete true, a finite non-empty 16x720 raster, one complete NPZ and one evidence-derived scan count.
baseline: V1 gate0_20260810_cano_exact_profile_creation_probe_v1_seed0 passed local USDA creation, 69-parameter SensorChecker validation and zero-mismatch attribute read-back, but direct get_data polling returned invalid GMO magic and produced zero complete scans. Its sealed scan count of one is a known exit-code-derived reporting error; missing NPZ and capture_failure are authoritative.

user_authorization.scope: One deterministic analytic test scene, one exact local-USDA RTX LiDAR, one pose, Writer-callback output, and at most one saved complete scan only; zero Cano worlds, formal dataset samples, labels, training, models, topology, M-TARE changes, sensor/backend substitutions, fallback, retry, or automatic 24-pose rerun.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: User message after the v2 proposal and stop boundary were presented: 继续

sensor_contract.output_api: Replicator Writer renderProduct callback with GenericModelOutput

acceptance_criteria: The new user approval, pinned Isaac image digest and every frozen tool/profile/USDA hash match before execution; the executed v1 result and NVIDIA image remain unmodified.
Lidar.create uses only the unchanged local USDA and creates exactly one valid OmniLidar prim; no config-name lookup, built-in sensor, deprecated camera path, CPU backend or fallback is used.

NVIDIA SensorCheckerUtil again reports no validation error and more than zero validated parameters; exact attribute read-back again has zero mismatches and derives 720 ticks and 11520 nominal rays per scan.
GMO is consumed only through a registered Replicator Writer renderProduct callback following the Isaac Sim 6.0.1 bundled test pattern; direct sensor.get_data polling is absent.
Within 300 render frames the Writer receives a legal parsed GMO with numElements greater than zero and scanComplete true.
The first complete scan has a 16x720 raster and more than zero finite valid cells; exactly one complete NPZ and one range-image preview are saved.
The complete diagnostic scan count equals one only when the NPZ and PASS capture summary both exist; process exit code alone cannot establish success.
Even PASS keeps Cano worlds, formal dataset worlds/samples, labels, train/validation/test samples, trajectories, models, topology and M-TARE changes at zero and does not authorize the 24-pose rerun.
stop_conditions: Any approval, image, tool, source-profile, USDA, output-directory or command mismatch
USDA creation, OmniLidar type, schema application, SensorChecker or exact attribute read-back failure
No legal complete Writer-callback GMO scan within 300 render frames, zero returns, malformed output, wrong raster shape or no finite valid cells

Continuation would require changing any sensor value, output method beyond the approved Writer callback, using an NVIDIA built-in profile, modifying the registry/image, switching backend, using CPU output, changing the analytic scene, retrying, or resuming Cano
Run exceeds 900 seconds or result size would exceed 0.1 GB
expected_evidence: New approved v2 sensor-smoke card, frozen run spec/command, tool/profile/USDA/image hashes, environment snapshot, raw log, duration, exit code, RUN_STATE and final evidence manifest
Exact attribute_readback.json, sensor_checker.json, Writer callback/zero-element counts, GMO and capture summaries
At most one complete diagnostic NPZ scan and, only on PASS, one 16x720 range-image preview with machine-readable provenance
Explicit PASS/FAIL boundary, evidence-derived scan count, and explicit zero Cano/formal-dataset/label/training/model/topology/M-TARE counts

estimated_cost.compute: One short headless RTX GPU container in the pinned Isaac Sim 6.0.1 image plus at most one offline range-image rendering; network disabled and no dependency installation.
